previous_rejected_search_history.mechanism: self-authored scoped decision artifact plus internal-consistency validator

reproduced_failures.design: The historical same-model champion overrode repository low-radius in one of two repeated natural runs.
reproduced_failures.backend: The historical same-model champion replaced the adequate Python API in both repeated web runs.
reproduced_failures.self_authored_artifact: The previous candidate failed both design and both web primary repeats because repository status, source, and value were model-authored assertions.

refined_pathology.why: preserve/change decisions are self-asserted rather than bound to repository-derived evidence
refined_pathology.distinction: Decision claim is not decision evidence.

authoritative: accepted project design contract with a machine-readable component-shape value
parsed Python server entrypoint with an identifiable framework/protocol identity
repository-local executable current or required-capability check over declared files
repository_evidence_model.supporting: Reserved for repeated consistent implementation but not accepted alone by this candidate.
insufficient: generic Python function without backend identity
prose or model classification of evidence strength

receipt_contract.derivation_order: repository parser/check -> bounded evidence -> observed value -> preserve or challenge

freshness_model: Every retained evidence file and check input is hashed. Validation re-parses the anchors, reruns declared checks, reconstructs the receipt, and rejects any difference. Unrelated repository files are outside the fingerprint.

candidate.controls: 2/2 model controls and 16/16 declared deterministic/model controls

baseline_comparison.comparable_dimension: model invocations and four repeated primary decisions

gate.reason: The repository-binding mechanism passed all fixture, baseline, and guardrail gates, but no fresh normal-intent real design/web task was in scope for the mandatory post-selection live cycle. Fixture validation cannot self-certify that live requirement.
gate.rollback: Candidate remains evaluation-only; Navigator v19 and shipped product 2.0.0 remain active.

live_dogfooding.reason: No fresh real user design/web task was provided in this repository-scoped experiment. Reusing a known evaluation fixture as live evidence would be false credit.

claim_boundary: Repository binding is established on the repeated low-radius and working-Python fixtures and their declared controls. It is not yet a shipped behavior, universal repository truth extractor, architecture planner, Personal/Core transfer, token improvement, or live-task result.
version_decision: Keep 2.0.0 and Navigator v19 unchanged. No 2.0.x patch is justified until one fresh normal-intent live design/web task passes and the executable rollback threshold is observed.
readme_decision: Keep the existing product philosophy and rejection links. Do not add the proposed verified-behavior note before promotion.
next_action: On the next real normal-intent design or web task, run the frozen candidate without changing it; promote a 2.0.x patch only if that live cycle preserves the repository-bound scope, keeps adjacent layers independent, and passes rollback and release evidence. Do not build another schema.
